Maya Chen: Quick question - I had to get a PCR (NAAT) for an unexpected client site visit last week and my card shows $165 billed. Insurer marked it 'Not covered - screening'. Can this be appealed as a business expense?

Raj Patel: Hey Maya 30 many plans don't cover asymptomatic travel tests. However, we can file an appeal if you upload the itemized invoice, proof of payment, and documentation showing the test was required for a company trip.

Maya Chen: I uploaded the lab invoice + receipt and the client confirmation email to the benefits portal. Anything else I should include?

Raj Patel: That's perfect. If possible, ask the lab for the CPT code (often 87635 for NAAT). Also if you can get a short note from your manager or Jenna confirming it was mandatory for the visit, that'll help.

Jenna Alvarez: I can write a short 'confirmation of business requirement' letter. Maya, DM me the trip dates and Ill attach it to the claim.

Maya Chen: Thanks Jenna, sending details now. Will the lab's 'screening' label block reimbursement even with our note?

Raj Patel: It can influence initial adjudication but appeals reviewers consider business necessity docs. Weve had successful exceptions before when employer required testing for business travel.

benefits-bot: Claim created: case #B-20271123-7810. Status: awaiting documents. https://benefits.redwood.com/claims/B-20271123-7810

Maya Chen: Flagging this as urgent because the card balance is due Monday. :exclamation:

Finance Ops: If approved, tell us whether it should be reimbursed to your personal card or credited back to the corporate card. If personal and amount >$600 we'll need a W-9 on file.

Raj Patel: I requested an expedited review and added a short cover note linking the test to the client visit. Expedited reviews typically respond within 48-72 hours but aren't guaranteed.

Maya Chen: Appreciate it. Any other tips for increasing approval odds?

Raj Patel: Checklist for others who hit this: 1) itemized invoice with CPT/test name, 2) proof of payment, 3) employer/client requirement document, 4) manager confirmation or People Ops letter.

Jenna Alvarez: Letter sent to portal and attached to the claim.

benefits-bot: Document received for case #B-20271123-7810. Status: under review.

Maya Chen: Thank you everyone :pray:

Raj Patel: Well post the outcome here when adjudicated so others can reference.

Finance Ops: Noted for potential chargeback flow depending on outcome.
